# Accepted native-host evidence

These are the exact bytes downloaded from accepted GitHub Actions run `30431979046`,
observation job `90511044879`. `github-job-api-record.json.hex` is lowercase hex
with a normal text newline; tests decode it to recover the no-final-newline API bytes.

This directory is accepted native-host evidence only. It is not final seal evidence,
and it creates no calibration, profile, or final-seal authority.
